research_question: Does the source-default MetaQuotes Quasimodo reversal entry geometry create positive frozen 30-second XAUUSD persistence on fixed M5 or M15 lanes?

source_basis.source: MQL5 Automating Trading Strategies in MQL5 Part 49: The Quasimodo (QM) Reversal Pattern
reconstructible_rules: centered confirmed swing pivots with 5 bars on each side
alternating zig-zag; consecutive same-type pivots merge to the more extreme pivot
bearish QM = H,L,H,L with Head>Shoulder and final L<Leg; bullish mirror
skip a setup that reuses the last left shoulder
invalidate on completed close beyond Head

execution_contract.note: Only the source entry grammar is screened. Source EA stop/TP/risk management is intentionally replaced by the frozen DELTA P75 30-second economics so candidate families remain comparable.

gate.advance_if: at least one fixed lane passes all gates unchanged
gate.no_rescue_rule: No lookback/timeframe/rejection/session/side/exit tuning if both fixed lanes fail.
